name: hikvision-unifi-fire-bridge
description: Bridges a Hikvision thermal camera's fire and Temperature-Measurement-Alarm (TMA) events into a UniFi Protect Alarm Manager webhook - a camera fire alarm can ring a Protect siren, send a priority push, or drive any Alarm Manager action. Fail-loud by design: re-alerts every 60s while the fire stays active, proactively probes the Protect path so a broken webhook surfaces before a fire, and enforces strict TLS. NOT certified life-safety equipment: not a substitute for compliant smoke alarms, fire panels, or emergency procedures, and carries no safety certification. Use only in addition to properly certified fire detection, at your own risk.

variables.name: Hikvision user
variables.description: Restricted camera account with event/ISAPI read only (e.g. hik-operator).

variables.name: Hikvision scheme
variables.description: http or https toward the camera.

variables.name: Protect base URL
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the UNVR running Protect (certificate-valid hostname, e.g. https://unvr.example.com).

variables.name: Protect API key
variables.description: Minimum-scope Protect integration API key (sent as X-API-Key).

variables.name: Protect webhook URL override
variables.description: Optional full webhook URL; replaces base URL + webhook ID if your Protect version uses a different path.

variables.name: Fire event types
variables.description: Comma-separated eventType values treated as fire (case-insensitive). Empty = TMA,fireDetection,fire_detection,fireAlarm.

variables.name: Fire cooldown seconds
variables.description: Minimum gap between edge-trigger alerts per source.

variables.name: Re-alert seconds
variables.description: Re-alert interval while a fire stays active; 0 disables re-alerting.

variables.name: Active TTL seconds
variables.description: Active state expires after this many seconds of silence (anti-latch safety).

variables.name: Stream idle timeout
variables.description: Reconnect when the camera stream is silent this long.
